subject: general
question: A 100-m-long train passes an electric post in 6 seconds. The speed of the train is:
solution:
**Given:**

Distance (Length of Train) = 100 meters

Time = 6 seconds

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed = 100 / 6 = 16.67 m/s

Convert to km/h:

⇒ Speed = 16.67 × 3.6 = 60 km/h

**∴ The speed of the train is 16.67 m/s or 60 km/h.**
